CVE-2026-115909.title: zip: Unbounded Symlink-Target Handling Can Abort Or Exhaust Memory During Extraction
CVE-2026-115909.description: zip is a zip library for Rust that supports reading and writing simple ZIP files. CVE-2026-116272.title: MIME::Field::ParamVal versions before 5.521 for Perl do not flag a duplicate boundary parameter whose name contains a nested comment
CVE-2026-116272.description:
MIME::Field::ParamVal versions before 5.521 for Perl do not flag a duplicate boundary parameter whose name contains a nested comment.

A parameter written boundary((c))="A" or boundary(\))="A" is stored under that literal name rather than as boundary. A second boundary parameter is then not reported as a duplicate, and MIME::Parser splits the message on it.

Readers that skip comments as RFC 5322 allows take the first boundary instead. A remote sender can hide an attachment from a filter that relies on ambiguous_content() while the recipient's mail client shows it.

flowintel contains an authorization flaw in its user deletion functionality. Organization-scoped administrators (org admins) are able to delete platform-level administrator accounts through both the browser-based admin interface and the REST API.

- Removal of higher-privilege accounts that should be protected from lower-privilege roles

CVE-2026-99250.title: printk: Postpone kthread startup
CVE-2026-99250.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

printk: Postpone kthread startup

There have been various bug reports related to SMP systems hanging
on boot. The reports vary but seem to have some overlap with regard
to missed IPI's during SMP setup. The reports also show that
reverting NBCON console usage allows the bugs to disappear.

The NBCON kthreads for console printing are started very early
during boot using early_initcall(). Since these kthreads are
asynchronously enabling/disabling interrupts during early boot, they
may be interfering with early SMP setup on some hardware platforms.

Starting the console printing kthreads later has shown to avoid the
hanging on systems that could previously reproduce the issue.

Postpone kthread starting until after all arch initcalls have
completed.

CVE-2026-99328.title: HID: picoLCD: check for fb_deferred_io_init() error
CVE-2026-99328.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: picoLCD: check for fb_deferred_io_init() error

fb_deferred_io_init() allocates deferred I/O state, populating
info->fbdefio_state, or leaving it NULL if an error occurs.

Currently picolcd_init_framebuffer() ignores its return value.

Therefore if an error arises in fb_deferred_io_init() (for instance, due
to an allocation failure) info->fbdefio_state is left NULL.

When the file is subsequently opened, fb_open() will dereference a NULL
pointer (calling fb_deferred_io_open()).

Fix this by checking for the error.

Also correct cleanup ordering - defio is initialised after the sysfs file,
so cleanup defio first.
